svg.text: C's real API34 Grid uses three adaptive columns.
The prior selected source depicts four smaller columns.
This candidate evaluates a readable three-column arrangement.
p06/p07: exact C-verified CC0 photographic derivatives.
Former blocked p08/p09/p16/p17 now have photos.
p10–p15: independent CC0 replacements in every slot.
p12: same immutable photo identity as selected Reel/Detail.
View/Share act on selected p12; selection applies nothing.
Sharesheet delivery is not inferred from choosing a target.
Grid remains finite and has Back to reel.
rights, owner choice, and OS interactions not approved.
